analysis.note: results.gpu.gflops (107.2) supersedes the 75.35 figure from the original 7-rep quick sweep, which was contaminated by pipeline warmup rather than measuring true throughput -- the 120s run shows a flat +2.4%/min trend (within sampling noise), not the thermal decay originally hypothesized in docs/device-tiers.md. dispatch_overhead_ms and marginal_throughput_gflops still come from the separate multi-size regression (dispatch_analysis.py) and are kept for the shard-sizing calculation; marginal_throughput_gflops is likely itself modestly warmup-biased low, since it was fit from the same contaminated quick-sweep medians -- prefer results.gpu.gflops as F(d).
